Yes, definitely. Once I've saved a bookmark — especially if I've tidied up the title or written my own description — that's *mine*, and I'd want it to stay exactly as I left it. It would really bother me if I came back and found my careful wording had been quietly swapped out because the website changed something on their end. My notes and edits are the whole reason the saved version is useful to me.

So the saved bookmark should hold onto what I last approved and not go changing itself behind my back. If a page does update and I happen to want to pull in the fresh title or image, that should be my call to make deliberately — something I choose to do, with a heads-up, not something that just happens automatically. Left alone, it keeps what I saved.
